name: Open-ended embodied task generation
description: Open-ended embodied task generation: optimize the candidate specified by the paper and evaluate against the named benchmark.

requirements.hardware: See upstream requirements and task notes.

notes: The task distribution is generated dynamically and is not a finite benchmark list. Main experiments use a wheeled R2D2 robot; Appendix P evaluates an Ant quadruped with continuous 8-dimensional actions.
Official setup uses Apptainer (not Docker); consult repository README for GPU container build and bindings.

suite.unsupported_reason: Fitness requires a physics simulator or reinforcement-learning training loop (OMNI-EPIC PyBullet environments) that is not bundled.

limitations: Upstream commands and dependencies were inspected; costly training, paid APIs, and hardware experiments were not executed.
No complete, verified execution adapter has been established for this exact task; this package is an explicit implementation gap.
